stories.title: Straaljager neergestort bij Amerikaanse basis in Duitsland, piloot gebruikte schietstoel

en.title: Fighter jet crashes at U.S. base in Germany, pilot ejects safely
en.summary: An F-16 fighter jet crashed at Spangdahlem Air Base in Germany's Eifel region. The pilot ejected safely with minor injuries, and the aircraft was destroyed; the cause remains under investigation.

stories.title: Opluchting in Groenland en Denemarken over akkoord met VS maar ook twijfels

en.title: Relief in Greenland and Denmark over agreement with US but also doubts
en.summary: Greenland and Denmark expressed relief after resolving their conflict with the United States through an agreement expanding American military presence in Greenland. Trump's threat to annex Greenland has been withdrawn.

stories.title: Actrice Hayden Panettiere (36) overleed aan fentanyl-overdosis

en.title: Actress Hayden Panettiere (36) died of fentanyl overdose
en.summary: American actress Hayden Panettiere died last month from a drug overdose containing fentanyl, according to completed autopsy results. She was found unconscious in a South Carolina apartment.

stories.title: Met verhullend taalgebruik dringen rechts-extremisten door tot politieke partijen, waarschuwen veiligheidsdiensten

en.title: Right-wing extremists infiltrate political parties using obscured language, security services warn
en.summary: Security services warn that right-wing extremists are penetrating political parties through the use of concealed language and messaging tactics.

stories.title: Militair vliegtuig stort neer op Amerikaanse basis in Duitsland, piloot lichtgewond

en.title: Military aircraft crashes at U.S. base in Germany, pilot slightly injured
en.summary: An American F-16 combat aircraft crashed at a U.S. air base in western Germany on Tuesday. The pilot safely ejected before impact but received medical attention.

stories.title: Trump dreigt Iran weer met vernietiging en haalt bij de VN hard uit naar het Internationaal Strafhof

en.title: Trump threatens Iran with destruction and harshly attacks International Criminal Court at UN
en.summary: During his UN speech, the American president threatened to destroy Iran unless a peace deal is reached and criticized the International Criminal Court as a rogue institution.

stories.title: Trump roept landen op het ‘kwaadaardige’ Internationaal Strafhof de rug toe te keren

en.title: Trump calls on countries to turn their backs on the 'malicious' International Criminal Court
en.summary: Trump is urging nations to withdraw from the International Criminal Court, which he characterizes as malicious.

stories.title: Trump gebruikt VN-podium voor nieuwe oproep om Internationaal Strafhof te boycotten

en.title: Trump uses UN podium for new call to boycott International Criminal Court
en.summary: President Trump addressed the UN General Assembly, calling on ICC member states to leave the organization, stating the U.S. will not allow American military personnel to face investigation by what he views as an anti-American tribunal.

stories.title: NCTV en AIVD waarschuwen voor ‘bewuste normalisering’ van rechts-extremisme, ook bij politieke partijen

en.title: NCTV and AIVD warn of 'deliberate normalization' of right-wing extremism, also among political parties
en.summary: Dutch intelligence and counterterrorism agencies warn that right-wing extremists are attempting to normalize their ideology online, at demonstrations, and within political parties by presenting softer versions of their views to appear more acceptable.

stories.title: VS, Denemarken en Groenland tekenen akkoord, VS mag meer bases bouwen

en.title: U.S., Denmark, and Greenland sign agreement, U.S. may build more bases
en.summary: The United States, Denmark, and Greenland signed an agreement in New York allowing expanded U.S. military presence on Greenland, averting a crisis that threatened NATO unity.

stories.title: VS mag legerbases in Groenland bouwen na deal met Denemarken en Groenland

en.title: US allowed to build military bases in Greenland after deal with Denmark and Greenland
en.summary: The United States, Denmark, and Greenland reached an agreement on increased American military presence on the island, potentially resolving disputes over the strategically important and mineral-rich territory.

stories.title: De details van de Groenland-deal zijn bekend: VS mogen twee nieuwe militaire bases bouwen

en.title: Details of Greenland deal revealed: US permitted to build two new military bases
en.summary: The US will add two new military bases to its existing northwestern Greenland installation under the agreement. This deal differs from previous arrangements by incorporating Greenland's own interests.
